title: Inflation Reduction Act 2022 – Phần thuế năng lượng

versions.text: Inflation Reduction Act of 2022 – Tax Provisions. Clean energy tax credits: Production Tax Credit (PTC), Investment Tax Credit (ITC). Electric vehicle tax credits (Section 30D). Energy efficient home improvement credits. Corporate Alternative Minimum Tax (15% on large corporations). 1% excise tax on stock buybacks. IRS funding: $80 billion for enforcement and modernization.
